$comment: Blended cut (2026-10-04 test round; seamless-match and jump-match at Duration Short). Each case: the pick (`ids`), the levers (`timing`), the scopes it reads the same in, and the exact text. `approved`: the approved strings, copied byte for byte from the review page's strings. `ruleDerived`: the two-row multi-picks the approved multi-pick rule produces (canvas only). Never edit those two by hand: a wording change there comes back for approval. `hardCut`: the same two rows at every other duration and with the ignored levers, which keep today's hard-cut text; they share the rows' bodies with `approved`, so a reword of either row changes both together.

In the second shot the same jump carries on without a break, and the subject comes down and lands in the new place.
